Alpĭcus , a, um, adj. Alpes, a rare form for Alpinus,
I.Alpine: “PER MONTES ALPICOS,” Inscr. Orell. 1613 .—Subst. plur., the inhabitants of the Alpine regions. Alpicos conantes prohibere transitum concidit, Nep. Hann. 3, 4.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
